subject: DEFERRED (RULED s323): indirect method syntax on $scalar inside ( )/[ ] emits a FUNCALL — re-raise on a real CPAN cause line
description: Fable ruling (fable-answers-s323.md §3): leave open. Failure is LOUD (undefined function), indirect syntax is rare/discouraged, common spellings (Foo->m, $obj->m) unaffected. Not worth pre-R1 time. Repro: package Widget; sub show {...}; package main; my $r = [ show $w ]; — perl does $w->show, PCL emits main::show(...). Statement level is fine; only the nested form reaching PExpr's indirect-object pre-pass goes wrong (pre-pass doesn't fire there, or its rewrite is discarded downstream). Pre-existing at HEAD, confirmed not introduced by #190.
